What: Alarm.Alarms on every transmitter has direction Undefined. The master template has Input polling, so the instances diverged from it.
Effect: The driver does not read the alarm word. The 430 DP functions that unpack it into Alarm.HHH to Alarm.UR compute from a value that never changes, and the alerts on those bits are all inactive. The transmitter alarm chain is broken at its first link.
Fix: Set direction to Input polling on all 43, matching the master.

What: Config.FaultSubValueEnable on every transmitter is Input spontaneous; the master has In/Out polling on use.
Effect: The substitution enable cannot be written from the HMI.

What: Alarm.TimeoutClose on every valve has an active Input polling address with no connection and no poll group.
Fix: Configure like Alarm.TimeoutOpen: connection _Safestack, poll group _subValveSV.

What: Config.FaultSubValue on PX7, PX8 and PX9 is active with the XXX_DB placeholder still in the address.
HMI.VentSP, HMI.UnlockConfirmSP and HMI.WinCC_OA_InitiateDisconnectSeq are inactive.
Effect: Settings writes to those two setpoints go nowhere. The disconnect cannot be started through the HMI datapoint - unless the SequenceTrigger path from the earlier export still exists.
Fix: Activate, or confirm the replacement path.

What: RDP_ConnSeq.ReqCode goes to HMI.RDP_ConnSeq.HMI_ReqCode; DB84's struct is RDPConnSeq.
Effect: RDP requests may never reach the PLC.
Fix: Confirm the PLC struct name, then align.

What: The upper annular gate DP uses Cmd_Gate_UpperAnnConnSeq_DB, the name before the OI-15 rename.
Effect: If the rename landed, the three permissives point at a DB that does not exist.
Fix: Rename the DP to Cmd_Gate_Upper_Annular and re-point.

What: RDP_CmdGate has no PLC counterpart; every address is a placeholder.
HMI_Ack and FaultStep are configured on UBSR only.
Effect: Fault acknowledge and fault step work for one element of sixteen.

What: Archiving is enabled on exactly one valve DPE - State.Position, whose address is inactive - and disabled on every live one. Every alert is inactive.
Fix: Decide what to archive and which alerts to activate (HMI HOI-09, HOI-12).
